name: Will air sealing affect my home's indoor air quality?
description: Air sealing improves indoor air quality by blocking outside pollutants but requires proper ventilation to prevent moisture and ensure fresh air.

mainEntity.name: Will air sealing affect my home's indoor air quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective air sealing reduces the infiltration of dust, allergens, and pollutants from outside, generally improving indoor air quality. However, a tightly sealed home requires proper ventilation to prevent moisture buildup and maintain fresh air circulation. A practical tradeoff is that while sealing reduces uncontrolled air movement, we ensure that necessary mechanical ventilation is considered or installed to provide a continuous supply of fresh air, maintaining a healthy indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Air sealing improves indoor air quality by blocking outside pollutants but requires proper ventilation to prevent moisture and ensure fresh air.
